title.zh: CFTC Approves Coinbase Clearing as Derivatives Clearing Organization
title.en: CFTC Approves Coinbase Clearing as Derivatives Clearing Organization

current_state.zh: The CFTC has approved Coinbase Clearing as a registered Derivatives Clearing Organization, allowing Coinbase to clear derivatives trades under federal oversight and deepening regulated crypto derivatives infrastructure in the US.
current_state.en: The CFTC has approved Coinbase Clearing as a registered Derivatives Clearing Organization, allowing Coinbase to clear derivatives trades under federal oversight and deepening regulated crypto derivatives infrastructure in the US.
